This is the worst airline i ever travelled. We had so many issues and payments that pretty much ruined our vacation. Our flight was delayed and we had to run to catch our connection flight We made it just in time to do our check in and they made us pay $20 to check us in at the counter so we dont miss our flight. We try to check in our bags and we had to pay extra for the check in of our luggage because we didn't do it online. On the way back we try to do it online but the online booking did not work. Then we use the whatsapp service and it took one day to answer the message and they couldn't check in our luggage. Finally we had to call and wait over an hour to finally check in our luggage. On the way back our flight was delayed. If possible please avoid this airline.

A most disappointing experience on the Zurich–Malé service operated by an extremely dated A340-300. The seats seemed worn, uncomfortably hard, and not very adequate for a long-haul journey. The quality of the food was poor, and the portions were meagre. Most concerning, however, was the cabin temperature, which remained uncomfortably, unbearably hot for the duration of the flight. This created an oppressive environment that made rest impossible. Altogether, this flight reflected a worrying lack of attention to passenger comfort and basic service standards.

I booked a flight with my friend from Zanzibar to Dubai, even paid for seats next to each other. They overbooked the plane so much that my friend could not fly with me. She took another flight later. The employees at the check in were the worst, we didn't hear any "we are sorry for the situation". All we heard was they were doing us a favour and if we don't accept the later flight we can go home. Worst experience I had in 20 years of travelling. So if you book a 6h flight with your spouse and want to get rid of him/her, book with flydubai. They will take care of it.

The legspace in the A319 is not different from Ryanair, Service is hardly any better: we got a small bottle of water and a tiny piece of chocolate. Welcomed by two air hostesses who were struggling to interrupt their chat to welcome passengers. One passenger had the audacity to ask for some water before taking off and was told to wait. On arrival one of the crew members was on her phone in stead of saying goodbye to the passengers. On the positive side: the flight landed 15 minutes earlier in Amsterdam and they have a good app with good information. I also liked the digital luggage tag. Would I recommend Lufthansa? The leg Munich-Amsterdam was the final of a trip from Asia. Having spent three weeks there and having flown with Middle Eastern and Asian airlines the answer is simple: no. Avoid LH if there is a choice.

FRA-LHR return. The first flight began stressful with two gate changes and a lot of walking through the terminal. The service onboard was minimal. You get a small bottle of water and a piece of chocolate. Food and drinks for purchase were offered, but the snack I was interested in was sold out. The flights were on time (more or less) and the crews were nice. Overall Lufthansa is reliable but the inflight experience is rather poor.

Booked and paid for flight. Two days before departure, on Christmas Eve, the return flight was cancelled. I've reached out Trip.com, where I booked the tickets, they told me to reach out to Norse. Norse customer support is absolutely ridiculous. They have a chatbot that barely works and couldn't find my flight, then said an agent was going to reach out to me via e-mail, which they after over a week of waiting, just to tell me to fill a claim on their website. I filled the claim right away, they said they would respond to it in 6-8 weeks, and it's been three months and I never heard anything from Norse ever since then. I've followed up several times via e-mail, the only contact option they have, waited after the due date, and they never got back to me. I was never reimbursed for the ticket that was cancelled, and neither for the new flight I had to book that they asked me to open the claim.

They ran out of both meat options and the vegetarian options were disgusting. The snacks listed was not available and I was told to wait for the pre landing food, and not offered anything. The menu printed states it is for the Melbourne to Singapore flight but no snacks are available? My entertainment screen did not respond, and could not be used. When I told the stewardess, they told me to use the seat next to me.

The seat was quite worn, the headrest wouldn’t stay in place, and the power outlet was loose in its socket. The legroom was also very limited, which made the flight uncomfortable. The cabin crew seemed rather unfriendly — not rude, but definitely not warm or welcoming either. On both the outbound and return flights, they announced that there wasn’t enough of the items listed on the menu, so you basically got whatever was left. The food was bland and dry, and noticeably worse than what I’ve had on other airlines. The drink selection was limited and not great in quality either. The cola had lost its carbonation, and the orange juice tasted very low‑quality. Their website was also frustrating to use. It kept showing errors, it was hard to find anything, and several parts of the interface were filled with Chinese text. To be fair, the flights were on time, the check‑in process went smoothly, and the airline did get me from point A to point B without issues. So the basic requirements were met, even if the overall experience left a lot to be desired.
AF premium economy is definitely not worth the price. My food was abysmal, service by surly cabin crew, and the restroom was filthy=.

We flew from Perth to KL on the 21st March. It was a difficult day with a flight delay , bag tags being attached to the wrong luggage (not Air Asia's fault) and having to organise changed flights. Air sia were very good in helping us with these issues from providing lounge access and a food voucher in Perth to make up for the delay and arranging a later connecting flight free of charge to Kuching for my wife when she missed the original flight due to the bag tag mix up. I wanted to praise Air Asia for their terrific customer service during a difficult day. We have no hesitation in flying with them again.

The service was good overall, although the crew seems overworked and doing their best to make the experience as pleasant as possible. The food quality and quantity were very poor. My meal (chicken with polenta) was served cold, and the chicken appeared to be processed meat. The bread was also insufficient, as I received only one slice. Ironically, the bread is probably the best food EDW serves across breakfast, lunch, or dinner in economy class. After dinner, it took quite a long time for the cabin lights to be dimmed, seemingly because the airline prioritises duty-free sales over passenger comfort. During the night, the cabin temperature was extremely uncomfortable.  Edelweiss Air presents itself as a premium leisure airline and charges accordingly, but delivers a subpar experience including catering and onboard product. The only real strength is the crew who are professional and dedicated.

I conclude that they are truly worse than a budget carrier. I received a horrendous customer service on-board flight by a cabin supervisor who was unable to manage a difficult passenger sitting on the other end of my row who was trying to take a nap at 5pm, so he came up to me to command me to close the window shades. I explained to him I was feeling unwell and wanted to leave it slightly open (1/4 open and 3/4 closed). He refused! He said that there’s another passenger across the aisle that is complaining and I should comply with his request. Only when I ask him if I fainted on board, would he be responsible, did he say it was my right to leave the window shades open and he will handle it with that lady. Many people had their window shades opened. Mine was three quarter 3/4 closed. Does it make sense that instead of forcing me, he should have given her an eye mask instead?  Inefficiency of Customer Service Team with replies almost only once a month. Upon arrival, I noticed damage made to my luggage. My flight landed in Singapore on 29 Dec 2025, I wrote in on 29 Dec 2025, received one reply on 29 Jan 2026 and the next reply on 23 Feb 2026 with only a partial reply on both emails. I asked the customer service staff Najma a simple question 5 times but up till the end of March 2026, I am still unable to get a refund or an answer.

The mobile check in process is a nightmare. Apparently, you cannot change your passport between the time you buy your ticket and the time you fly. Even if you update the information multiple times in your online account, the mobile check in system still doesn't recognize your new passport number. You also have to have a really steady hands to scan your passport, the system is finicky and you have to hold your camera for long time for the scanner to scan your info and then, in the end, it will tell you that the passport does not match info on file.
Attendants are nice and helpful and the food is great too. A better variety of movies would be nice tho. WiFi service would be great too. Overall the service is impressive.

First and last time flying with BA. A bad experience £560 one way + £96 for a seat coerced into buying by BA system. Booked a seat because the system only showed occupied seats only 5 seats available so after paying £96 for Aisle seat went to screenshot i then found there was now 42 seats available after paying! I could have  booked free seat 24 hrs before my flight so was falsely led into believing the flight was near fully booked at time.Asked for a refund but i was declined this is unfair practice. Food was terrible  - ate 1 muffin as nothing else was edible. Toilets dirty,  ran out of toilet tissue. Galley is closed off for staff - staff cut me at the toilet. Rude Staff. In turbulence the Overhead lockers opened i jumped up and closed them 10 seats ahead of me to stop luggage falling on passengers - no sign of staff to help. Only to be shouted at to sit down as the Seat Belt sign was on. Seats are cramped not comfortable. I would not recommend BA

I am close to retaining Bronze status for the next year. My Tier points collection ends on 31st March 2026. I took a return flight from London to Buenos Aires with their partner Iberia. I claimed the tier points and Avios for the outbound flights. They came in less than a week. I claimed the points for the return flights a month ago but nothing has come. I tried chat (no help whatsoever) and the online form (no answer ever) They have deliberately delayed my points and will apply them no doubt immediately after 31st March 2026 so I get pushed back to Blue status. British Airways hates anyone who travels Economy to be anything but Blue. I tried to transfer some Vueling Avios to British Airways but it didn't work. I contacted them too but of course no reply. Do not join their Club.

Amsterdam to Tokyo via Taipei and then Tokyo to to Vienna via Taipei.  I don't think China Airlines provides the same level of amenity as EVA or Starlux but all three airlines are top class. China Airlines in my opinion offers the friendiest service and it's food offers were also of high standard. On the outbound journey I used the CI lounge at TPE terminal 2. It's not my favorite lounge but it has good food options. Service was also very attentive. I was lucky to be served by a very friendly Japanese crew. And the Japanese set menu they offered on this short haul flight was far superior than other airlines. Check in at NRT airport was done by JAL - very friendly and efficient. Lounge at NRT airport was not busy and service was really good. The flight was wonderful. The cabin manager and the crew in charge of my section were both super helpful. Again food on board was good. Taipei to Vienna probably one of my best flight. Check in at TPE airport again was hassle free. The lounge at Taipei terminal 1 is not my favorite lounge as it's not large enough during peak hours but the staff were outstanding.  I was on queue and was about to give up my shower slot but the agent told me boarding would be late as the plane was just being refueling and it will take some time and she ensured me that I still had time for a shower. The crew in charge of my section was super professional, seat was comfortable and the duvet was high quality. I chose a meal by T&T, a michelin starred restaurant in Taipei but there were few other Michelin starred meals if you pre book it. When we arrived at Vienna we had to use a remote stand but there was a bus for business class passengers. The wifi CI provided is too slow and it only allows one device to be connected at one time. The amenity in the toilet is very basic. Also premium economy passengers shared the two toilets with business class.

During booking, we encountered a system glitch, and there was no accessible way to contact customer service by phone. We reached out through chat support to request a reschedule, but instead of receiving any courtesy adjustment, we were required to pay a fare difference. To make matters worse, the representative rebooked us on the wrong date, and we were then asked to pay another fare difference to correct the mistake. We will not be using this airline again.

The last flight LHR-ADD-CPT had a 30 minute transfer at ADD. Unfortunately you have to go through a security check in the transit lounge which is a complete pain  but that is the only difficulty. Our bags made the connection! The CPT-ADD-LGW was A350 first leg & B787 second leg. Service & food were extremely good on the first leg. As the second leg departed after midnight we just put the beds out & slept. Travelling to London includes two  episodes of security bag checks and of final one they impound the water you have just bought in the departure lounge. Beds were comfortable and service levels higher than British Airways. Free wifi for Biz is supplied but iffy in places

I was scheduled for a 0630 Flight from Chicago to Houston on 8/18/2025. At 0030, I received a message on my phone that the 0630 flight had been canceled. After checking with Frontier, at 0100, and finding out there were not any other flights from Chicago to Houston, on this date, I had to try to find another carrier to get home. I did find one, but it cost $700 more than the Frontier ticket, that was already purchased. Once in Houston, I found the Frontier counter and asked to be indemnified, for the inconvenience endured due to their cancellation. The customer service representative at the Frontier counter gave me two, $20 food vouchers for the airport food court. She stated that was all she could do. So, I contacted Frontier customer service, and requested to be indemnified for having to purchase $700 tickets from another carrier. I was refunded the cost of my Frontier ticket from Chicago to Houston. But, after a month of back-and-forth, and not being fully indemnified, I stopped hearing from them.

During the flight, my toddler became unwell and vomited on me and our seats. The cabin crew were kind and helpful in assisting us. They provided me with a wet towel, helped my husband clean the seats, and used a spray to help with the odor. They also provided blankets to place over a he seat. After I had cleaned myself and my toddler in the bathroom, one of the flight attendants m brought me water. I am very grateful for the care and support we received. The crew were professional, attentive, and genuinely helpful throughout the situation.

A canceled flights on our initial leg, complete chaos at the gate and horrific communication. A refund WinAir promised on March 6 and 20 days later and I have not seen a refund, nor are they answering my follow up emails. A local agent told me that WinAir was turned into a chaotic airline and advised me to switch to St. Bart’s Commuter.

The last flight LHR-ADD-CPT had a 30 minute transfer at ADD. Unfortunately you have to go through a security check in the transit lounge which is a complete pain  but that is the only difficulty. Our bags made the connection! The CPT-ADD-LGW was A350 first leg & B787 second leg. Service & food were extremely good on the first leg. As the second leg departed after midnight we just put the beds out & slept. Travelling to London includes two  episodes of security bag checks and of final one they impound the water you have just bought in the departure lounge. Beds were comfortable and service levels higher than British Airways. Free wifi for Biz is supplied but iffy in places

A new A321NEO, comfortable leather seat, the captain provided update flight path details. Inflight its nonstop playing Vietjet’s own music. Attendant seem lack in English speaking and disappeared after safety demo AND prior to landing. Other Pax bringing airport food to consume inside the plane and seat never adjust.

After waiting for them to fix mechanical issues for 2 hours, they cancelled the flight and had a single employee try to rebook the entire horde of passengers. They were unable to provide a replacement flight till 24 hours later, and the app/website is run abysmal. We then had to wait another 3 hours for the luggage.

It’s a decent airline. Food was decent for RDU to CDG. We took the chicken option, which wasn’t that bad. However, when we went from CDG to DEL, the quality deteriorated. The seats were  cramped and uncomfortable. The food was not that good compared to the first flight. The main meal, which was Aloo- Palak Masala (potatoes and spinach with spices added) was bad. The flatbread felt undercooked. However, the inflight entertainment was not limited, but do more Indian options. However, the staff was very kind and helpful.  The staff was helpful at explaining new things, like the wheelchair process.

Great service! I had a connecting international flight and somehow the ground personnel knew that there were long lines at Immigration so they sent one of the Airlink employees to escort me from Domestic arrivals to International departures and through the fast track Immigration.

I book my flight back from Penang to Subang and I was notified that it will be landing at KLIA instead The reason why I chose to land back in Subang is so that I can get back home faster and hence I paid more for the ticket. The ground staff told me that the flight to Subang is cancelled. I will never travel with Batik Air, first and last.

Check in was efficient. Lounge was good with great food and good beverages. The toilets in the BA lounge at Cape Town are noticeably cleaner than they are in their Lounge at T5. Boarding was efficient. I love the muted colours of BA business class. Everything in the seat worked with the minor exception of scratching and popping from the headphones if you jiggled the cable. Drinks came promptly. I had a fantastic cabin attendant who had perfect old school charm. What a delight he was. So good that I have found the page on the BA website where you can compliment someone and I have done so. The food out of Cape Town is Newrest and not as good as the Do & Co out of Heathrow. My soup was served lukewarm. My main was OK. IFE worked fine. Great nights rest. Bags arrived promptly. I deduct a point for being served cold soup and a point for the two flight attendants chatting away who kept me waiting a long time to get past them even though one could see i wanted to get to the toilet. It was not work related chat but middle of the night gossip. I have flown Singapore Business recently and this would never happen.

They had me pay NZD 244 at check-in because according to their staff on the airport my luggage with ski equipment was oversized. I had them measure the dimensions of my bag and after reviewing their terms and conditions it turned out my total bag dimensions were well within the maximum dimensions, meaning they should allow it for free. I got home and emailed their customer service about this unreasonable charge. I got zero response. When I arrived in Guangzhou it turned out that the China Southern Airlines crew at Christchurch airport had cancelled my ticket from Guangzhou to Beijing. Luckily the customer service in Guangzhou could get me a new ticket, but I had to go through customs 3 times to get that sorted. The food I was served onboard was disgusting.

A350-1000 is clearly a wonderful airplane. Nice 1-2-1 configuration. Clean and well maintained. The crew beautifully dressed, attentive and with warm beautiful smiles. F&B? Pre departure champagne comme il faut. A wine list not the price class of the gulf carriers, but the level of KLM, LH. The mains were ok. But really good were the ethiopian national dishes served before. I did not understand the flight map, there were two flight path. I asked and the captain came from the flight deck and explained.

Traveling with Icelandair was the single worst travel experience I've ever had. My wife and I were visiting Iceland for a short trip for a wedding. We planned far in advance, showed up early to the gate, and were told, oops, we overbooked the flight and only have 1 seat. One of you should fly and only one of you will receive compensation. I booked the hotel and rental car for arrival, so I should just go? How can I go and leave my wife behind? They told us too bad, refused to let us on the plane, and the gate agent left. We were rebooked 24 hours later and it took Icelandair months and countless emails back and forth before they gave only 1 of us the minimum compensation required by law. It was a nightmare and they should be ashamed of treating people so badly. Choose another airline.

This airline has shown an unacceptable lack of professionalism. Their ground staff placed stickers directly on my passport, and removing them has been extremely difficult. A passport is a critical legal document, and treating it so carelessly is simply irresponsible. If the staff cannot handle something as basic as respecting passengers’ travel documents, it raises serious concerns about the overall standards and attention to detail within the airline. This experience has left me with very little confidence in their service or operational discipline.

The crew on this flight did an outstanding job. Aperitif followed with a four course lunch, outstanding wines with continuous refills. Extremely attentive and gracious crew passing by regularly on this flight, asking if everything was okay or something was needed, I couldn’t have been spoiled more. This was really good!

Great flight experience. Offered to check in carry on bag for free at check in desk which was very helpful. Very quick and easy boarding. Helpful and friendly cabin crew. Plane comfortable. Offered a complimentary bun and drink on board.  Upon arrival easy disembarking.

I endured a two-hour delay awaiting my luggage. Despite the display at the baggage carousel indicating a 'finished' status, my items had not arrived, necessitating a visit to the Lufthansa Service Desk. The staff there appeared overburdened After a protracted wait, I was informed that the luggage had been processed and was instructed to retrace my steps entirely to the reclaim area.
Really strict on luggage I was 1kg over and had to remove things or pay. Equipment is not good. My entertainment system didn’t work. Leg room was very poor. Only good thing was free wifi /internet.

A350-1000 is clearly a wonderful airplane. Nice 1-2-1 configuration. Clean and well maintained. The crew beautifully dressed, attentive and with warm beautiful smiles. F&B? Pre departure champagne comme il faut. A wine list not the price class of the gulf carriers, but the level of KLM, LH. The mains were ok. But really good were the ethiopian national dishes served before. I did not understand the flight map, there were two flight path. I asked and the captain came from the flight deck and explained.

Ended up on ANA after Qatar Airways cancelled my flight. It was a long trip, but it was okay. Polite crew, reasonable food, lots of snacks when you ask for it, rather good legspace which is important on the 15+ hour leg BKK-MUC and good entertainment. Since I had a 7-hour layover at Haneda Airport I purchased lounge access and that was good too. Good food, plenty of drinks, lots of space including cosy corners to work and fantastic toilets. No power sockets though, which was strange. All in all a good experience

An uneventful domestic flight with a new but weirdly looking A320neo. Slim seats, old-fashioned carpet and modern overhead bins. Service provided by the staff was friendly and professional, their English without any strong accent. Only drinks were served. Upon arrival in Rome were buses to gate, which took look time as the plane was full.

I paid for front seats on a flight and the stewardess allowed a standard seating passenger to sit next to me for free. The woman was rather overweight and her posterior encroached on to my seat for the entire journey. As well as removing her shoes she stank for the entire journey. She said she was too large for a standard seat. The stewardess claimed it was on medical grounds!  The seat bases were also very small. I have asked Jet2 for a refund as she allowed the free upgrade to the woman. Worst flight I have ever had and there have been quite a lot.

I inadvertently arrived at the wrong gate. Upon realizing the error, I rushed to the correct gate. Even though the aircraft had not departed, the gate agents refused to let me board. A staff member informed me that if I went to the service desk, they would reschedule me on another flight the same day. This turned out to be false. At the service desk, the representative was dismissive. She claimed she was making a one-time exception by rescheduling my flight, yet charged me 250€ to do so. This is not an exception or a favor, it is the price of a new ticket, and I feel I was lied to regarding the nature of this change.

I purchased a Riyadh-Ankara via Istanbul ticket through the Pegasus app for March 15th. Upon arrival in Riyadh, the operating partner, Flynas, had no record of my booking. Pegasus had failed to sync the data or settle the booking. I was forced to buy a last-minute ticket out of pocket. For the next 13 days, I contacted Pegasus daily via every possible channel (Email, Phone, Social Media) to ensure my return flight on March 28th would not face the same issue. I was repeatedly ignored with "we are looking into it" scripts. Predictably, on March 28th, I was stranded again in Istanbul. Flynas ground staff stated that Pegasus failed to transfer the payment for my seat, rendering my confirmed ticket invalid. My luggage was stuck in transit, and I had to purchase yet another ticket to return home. Pegasus promotes itself as a "Digital Airline," yet they cannot manage a simple interline payment or respond to a high-priority customer warning for 13 straight days.

While booking the ticket from the company's website, I carefully read the price conditions of the ticket, and selected the one which was fully refundable because there was a high possibility to cancel the trip. When I tried to cancel the ticket later, I found no way to do it online, I had to send an email to the IT department of the company. And, even though I sent them a mail 3 hours prior to the flight time, they devided to deduct $100 no-show penalty and like $15 service fees, which is of the ticket price. Niether the website nor the ticket confirmation I already recieved by the email contains any information about the no-show rules, nor the service fees. When I sent a complaint to the customer service, thier response was just an appology for the "latest experience".

I flew on Air India Flight No AI-2353 from BKK to BOM on 25th March and had a mixed experience. The flight arrived on time, the aircraft was new and clean but the seat pitch was too little, making it uncomfortable. I had ordered a special meal, but it was not catered for and I had to opt for the regular meal. The hostesses were polite, helpful and enthusiastic, but took almost 30 minutes to start the service after the seat belt sign was switched off and they kept running back & forth, resulting in very slow service. Drinks and meals were served together. So overall, the inflight experience was not very good and needs to be improved.

This is the worst experience I have ever had with an airline or travel company. The level of communication and assistance offered by Etihad after the US and Israel attacked Iran, disrupting airspace in the middle east, was non-existent. We had flown out to visit our son on the 19th February, a week before hostilities broke out. Due to fly home on the 7th March, our flight was first rescheduled earlier the same day and then cancelled 6 hours before take off. The only emails we received after that were Etihad trying to get get us to accept a refund for the return leg so they could cut us loose. We ended up having to book tickets home from Singapore via Tokyo 2 weeks later and £5000 more than planned. I can only imagine the situation some travellers found themselves in if they didn't have any spare cash. Terrible, terrible airline. In contrast, Japan Airlines and British Airways were superb (aside from charging £1600 each for a one way ticket home).

I recently travelled with Hong Kong Airlines in business class. On both sectors, my seat call button was not working. My IFE system was either slow or unusable on one leg. After raising these issues, I did not receive any meaningful response. On my return journey, I was downgraded on one sector. However, the airline denied that any downgrade occurred, claiming that I had travelled in business class.

Flew Gulf Air Business Class and paid a little under 5K USD for 2 tickets on the advertised Boeing 787-9 Apex Suite product. What was delivered was a MIAT Mongolian Airlines aircraft, operated under a wet-lease arrangement that was never disclosed, not at booking, not at check-in or at the gate. The MIAT aircraft had no Wi-Fi (advertised as standard on Gulf Air's 787-9, and our pre-booked center-pair seats were reassigned without any notice, separating us for the flight. Gulf Air's formal response after waiting three months for them to reply to our complaint, was a measly USD 100 flight vouchers per passenger. In addition on the same flight one of our 4 luggage also sustained damage during this journey. Gulf Air initially denied the claim citing the absence of a Property Irregularity Report, despite us reporting it within the 7 days required by the airline, and even After providing timestamped photographic evidence, correspondence went silent. Would not suggest this airline, and do not count on their customer service.

I had a truly pleasant experience flying with Malaysia Airlines. From the moment I arrived at the airport, the check-in process was smooth, efficient, and well-organized, making the start of the journey stress-free. Onboard, the aircraft was impressively clean and felt very spacious, providing a comfortable environment throughout the flight. The seating arrangement allowed for ample legroom, which made a noticeable difference, especially on a longer journey. What stood out the most was the exceptional cabin crew. They were warm, attentive, and consistently professional, going above and beyond to ensure passengers were comfortable and well taken care of. Their genuine hospitality made the flight feel welcoming and relaxed. The food quality was also excellent—well-prepared, flavorful, and thoughtfully presented, adding to the overall enjoyable experience. Overall, Malaysia Airlines delivered a high standard of service across all aspects of the journey.

Singapore to Manchester I was upgraded from Premier economy to business class.  Whilst the upgrade was appreciated I'm not a big fan of the seating in Singapore airlines business class, I find it very uncomfortable as it felt rather claustrophobic with little legroom. The food that I was given in the business class was that which I had previously ordered for my Premium economy seat. It was very tasty and I enjoyed it. The cabin crew were excellent but a special mention to Cheng who was was extremely friendly and professional. Singapore airlines are a good carrier, however I believe they should change their seating in their business class cabins to make it far more comfortable for tall passengers like myself.

We arrived at airport and they had us sitting on the tarmac for 45 min while they overbooked our flight to Charlotte from Ft Lauderdale. No one met us at the plane when it arrived to assist. Then they had us walk 2 miles to gate F6 then that lady had us walk 1.5 miles to gate G10. We waited in that line 30 minutes then the lady said if u don’t have an email from Spirit u have to walk another mile to baggage claim. We got there and it was a mile long line. To top it off several from our flight made it to the gate where the Charlotte flight was boarding and they were not let on then other people came up and they let them on. Said flight was overbooked.

Awful airline. Two hour delay with almost zero communication. Misinformation from their very rude counter staff when we tried to rush to make another plan. Missed our connecting flight and left stranded in St Martin. Stay away!

Very poor experience with Jetstar. The service was lacking, and some staff felt unwelcoming. What made the situation worse was how rigid and unreasonable their baggage policy was. We were traveling as a family and, combined, had around 110kg of checked baggage allowance. Even though our total baggage was well below that (around 80–90kg), we were not allowed to combine allowances because one of us booked separately using miles. Despite clearly being under the total limit as a group, the staff were strict and refused to accommodate us. On top of that, our hand-carry weight exceeded the limit by almost exactly the amount of unused checked baggage we had. Even then, they would not allow us to move items into our checked allowance. It made no sense and showed zero flexibility.  Overall, the experience left a very negative impression.

We travelled as a family from Minsk to Bangkok with Uzbekistan Airways, connecting in Tashkent. The connection in Tashkent splits the journey into two segments of roughly similar length, which is a huge advantage when you travel with kids.  On the return flight, where the catering was loaded in Tashkent, my wife said it was the best airplane meal she has had. Our children loved the gift bags and backpacks they received, as well as cartoons and games on the IFE.  The cabin crew were attentive and patient with the children. I would also like to highlight the honesty and professionalism of the ground team.

T5 lounge fairly good. We got bulkhead seats for both legs. Seats not particularly comfortable. Food pretty inedible. Staff good. We're silver so able to book seats, good price for fare. In flight entertainment grim on outbound leg.Went hand baggage only, which was excellent at Nashville airport.

I had a JetBlue flight LHR->JFK->DEN on 16 March because of weather conditions. Once I finally landed in JFK, I missed my connecting flight and had to spend the night in JFK. JetBlue sent me an email with link to book a hotel, which did not work. Customer Service in JFK was unable to figure it out, so told me to book my hotel and file for reimbursement. I did as I was told and was told to call 1-800-JETBLUE or talk to them online (via chat) to file reimbursement. Being unable to call the 1-800 number (having a UK number) and due to long wait times for the online chat, I was only able to do this today on 1 April. I was told that because I missed the 10-day window, they were unable to reimburse me for the hotel. I informed them I was never told about the 10-day window by the Customer Service rep, and it was not in my email. After 2 hours on the chat, they were unable to resolve the issue. I have contacted their "Share a concern" here and would like to know what I can do to get reimbursement, as I missed the deadline to file not through my own incompetence, but because I was given incomplete information.
The airline cancelled our flight at the same day, they send us a message in another language, which was so confusing for us. That means more money and time.

I called Qantas customer service line to ask about an upgrade and whether I would have a bassinet seat for my 4 month old baby and she could not confirm anything and told me my seat was in economy when I had bought an economy plus seat. I was not able to ascertain any information from that call. I tried to check my seats online and couldn’t get a seat map for the flights. For my first flight I was actually not even on the flight - I spent 45 minutes in the lounge waiting for the staff to assign me a seat as I was not guaranteed to fly as somehow I was on standby even though I bought the flights together weeks ago. I then was given a middle class in the final rows of the plane for JFK to LAX. I was told at JFK that there were many empty business class seats for LAX to SYD and I could purchase my upgrade to business class at LAX airport and at the lounge. I walked a long way to the lounge with my baby and was told by the staff there that my name had been noted and I was good to go for an upgrade to business class. They said I needed to pay at the Gate. I went to the gate and was very rudely told by the staff there that the tickets had been given away to others. Then they sent me into economy when I had an economy plus seat so had to wait another 15 minutes to be brought to the right area. All around very disappointing experience.

PAL had a good offer from PVG to BKK with stopover in MNL in Business Class. Just 100 Euro more expensive then economy, therefore i choose to try their business class. Both flights have been in time and arrive even 30 mins ahead of schedule. Lounge in PVG is the China Eastern Lounge. Not bad, generous seating, food was ok. Flight PVG to MNL was old 2-2-2 configuration but comfortable with plenty legroom. Crew was very friendly. The dinner was a 3 course meal which taste great. Wine selection was ok. Wi Fi did not work. I have been many times in MNL and it always take a bit longer to get out of airport but this time it was great and I manage to get all done within 15 minutes.=MNL to BKK was a different seat configuration but comfortable with friendly crew and nice lunch and this time the WiFi works good. PAL lounge in MNL was ok. IFE on both flights a bit under average, totally ok for 3 hours flight but for long haul i would prefer more options. Overall it was good value for money, even the cabin looks a bit worn and a refurbishment would not be a bad idea.

Cabin crew were kind and lovely on the long haul flight, even giving us a tour of the business class aswell as a free snack, however the breakfast provided was awful. A plastic bag filled with unwanted treats from 7-Eleven. Jelly, cake, dry bun with a dry filling was considered proper breakfast after 12 hours in flight. The lavatories were also quite dirty, with stains and rubbish bins being full after just an hour in the air. Keep in mind, you will not be handed a wet wipe. I would strongly recommend anyone flying long-haul with SAS to bring extra wet wipes as well as something you can prepare in-air to eat. Or choose a different airline for long-haul if that is possible, as they rarely reply or fix issues.
Today again waiting for more then an hour, and waiting to leave. No communication in the plain, no water offered waiting. Terrible service.

BKK-PVG on A-350 Economy Class. Flight was in time, aircraft fairly new and in good condition. For food they had two choices, among it my favourite thai dish, Pad Thai. Of course not in a restaurant quality but taste was good. For drinks they serve several non alcoholic beverage as well as wine. Crew was friendly. Check in in BKK was self service with friendly help of ground staff. After arrival luggage arrives fast. Overall a nice 3 hour flight.

All flights have been in time (except one hour delay BKK-IST ) which not matter to me as i had long layover anyhow. Lounge in Hannover was quiet basic, few snacks available and basic selection of drinks. Short distance business seats have been comfortable considering the competition in Europe which usually offer normal eco seats with a spare seat in the middle. During the short flights they serve a lunch (3 courses) which all taste good.Wide selection of drinks. The lounge in Istanbul was one of the best i have seen, nice food, many different kind of drinks including turkish specialities like Ayran from the barrel, turkish coffee and tea. Unfortunately a bit full there. Long haul business class on B-787 was great. If you fly alone you have a lot of privacy in this seat. However after few hours it feels a bit narrow in this shells but nothing really to complain about. Great selection of food served by onboard chef and a wide selections of drinks. Free wifi was available and worked good. IFE also almost perfect. Crew was on all flights very kind and professional. Felt very welcome there.

I had to travel to Mumbai and there was this flight by AI at 11pm so I went ahead with booking that flight. Check in was seamless and it seems that the load in Y class was on the lighter side. Boarding started on time and the staff called out by zones which made the process more orderly. This was the first time I was travelling on the refurbished airbus A320 neos of AI. While the seats in economy were good, they had USB power points and mobile stands, they had reduced the seat pitch slightly (but not too much that your knees touch the front seat). Departure was on time and as this was a late night flight they offered some snacks (chicken keema and pav for non veg and pasta for veg along with a cake and hot beverages). Whiley they do have inflight streaming called the vista, I did not try it out so cannot really say how it was. One thing I noticed was that there were some crew announcements in the regional language too which was appreciated as India has lots of multiple regional languages so having those messages shared to the pax was a good touch. Landing was on time however the baggage retrieval took a bit of time. So overall this was not a bad flight at all.

Terrible. An 8-hour delay. The price, which was normal, suddenly jumped during the booking process. It's truly appalling. It severely impacted the customer's schedule and experience.  Tệ. Delay 8 tiếng. Giá đang bình thường thì nhảy vọt trong quá trình đặt.thực sự rất tệ hại . Làm ảnh hưởng cực kì lớn đến lịch trình cũng như trải nghiệm của khách hàng

We purchased our tickets via Trip.com for flight MU9647 from Kunming to Singapore, scheduled at 21:30 (revised timing) on 31 March 2026. Our seats were selected and confirmed at the time of booking. However, due to a flight retiming, our pre-selected seats were cancelled without reinstatement. When attempting to reselect seats online, the system did not allow any changes and instead required us to complete seat allocation during check-in. To our surprise and disappointment, we were assigned separate middle seats at check-in. This was highly inconvenient and unacceptable, particularly as we had already secured our seats in advance and the change was not initiated by us. Although the ground staff and duty managers attempted to assist, we were informed that all seats had been allocated and no further action could be taken. Theduty managers appeared unable to take proactive steps to resolve the issue, and their responses suggested limitations in coordinating seat adjustments, despite indicating otherwise. T

Flight crew were friendly and efficient. However, regarding the food, the “Smoked Duck” starter was actually chicken and beef Tenderloin not available. We were in row 2 and out already. When asked, flight crew advised that there were only 3 beef tenderloin entrees available for 30 business class seats. Uncomfortable, old seats (diamond) with virtually no storage options. WiFi was extremely poor and slow.

They split my daughter and I up on two different flights. The flight attendant from Dallas to Albuquerque was not a nice person. Nor helpful. The WiFi didn’t work in a single one of the four flights. Not a good airline anymore.

I recently flew British Airways from LHR to NCL and was surprised at how poor the experience was for such a short, simple route. Boarding was disorganised from the outset. The whole boarding group process is ridiculous. I was told there was no space left for my cabin bag, despite boarding having only just started, and was made to check it in. Once on board, it was clear that wasn’t true, there were still plenty of empty overhead lockers, even after boarding had finished. The crew didn’t set a great tone either, chatting amongst themselves during boarding with no real acknowledgement of passengers when they boarded. Announcements were difficult to understand, snacks ran out, and neither the seat power nor WiFi were working. If this is the standard on a quick Newcastle flight, it doesn’t inspire much confidence in how longer flights are run.

This is the best economy class I've ever experienced. The seat deserves particular credit which has spacious width and legroom owing to the 2-4-2 configuration on their B787 fleet. I'm over 6 feet tall and I'm usually cramped in economy class seats but this seat had ample space. Service was friendly and efficient with good food and wine. It's a shame not all economy class is as good as this. I left my wallet at the check in counter and only realised after I had passed security. I went to the Japan Airlines help desk and within 20 minutes they had my wallet waiting for me at the boarding gate. Fabulous.

When I arrived at the airport (JFK), my seat was re-assigned to row 18. Jetblue agents are extremely disrespectful and rude. They are unfriendly, I am a Mosaic member and selected row 5 for seat. I approached an agent that they claimed that the aircraft was changed and that they cannot do anything about it because it's a full flight. As we entered the plane there were so many empty seats in front of us. I even requested with the air hostess to move me upfront since my siblings were there and the denied me. Jetblue is no longer my preference to fly with there service is
Very pleasant and efficient service in terms of check-in, cabin cleanliness, seat width, seatback amenities, entertainment, cabin crew service, food and beverage and bag collection upon arrival.

On March 14, 2026, when I was claiming my baggage at Nassau Airport, I discovered that two of the four bags I had paid handsomely to check in were damaged, one completely unusable, and the other, a new one, dented. I did everything they asked me to request a refund at the airport, but so far, the only thing they're offering me is a discount on my next flight with Bahamasair, which I will clearly never use again. I would like to know if there's anything I can do to get the refund I'm entitled to.

Frontier makes customers pay hefty extra for getting a seat upfront so that they can get cabin space for carry on luggage. But it does not honor that pricing - it allowed everyone to board at the same time. The boarding agents didn't seem to care as Frontier and Spirit are known for - finally we paid more and ended up leaving our luggage way behind in the flight. When I informed the flight stewardess her response was 'your bag goes under your seat because the flight is full'.

We were very unhappy with the Hi Fly flight from Mahe to Paris. Our Etihad flight was changed unannounced to Hi Fly. We flew business class. It was not enough water and it 100ml glass was offered only three times. I got one bottle, but second time i have got a response that there is not enough water for business class passengers, so i got none. The flight duration is 10 Hours by the way. No Onboard entertainment included. Passengers could play with their mobile phones and connect to some wifi onboard, but for this you need a mobile phone, your own headphones and enough battery life with charger. Options for music and movies very limited! It was the worst food experience on a business class trip we have ever had. There was no menu and the quality of food was extremely low. It was served in aluminum foil , with plastic fork and plastic knife. No tea, no coffee offered. Dirty cabin. No Amenity Kit,  no slippers, no toothbrush, no headphones, no ear plugs and so on.. Not recommended - totally not worth it for this amount of money. Just fly somewhere else.

My flight from Denpasar to Solo, originally scheduled at 10:00 AM, was rescheduled to 6:10 PM — more than 8 hours delay — only 3 days before departure. No proper explanation was given, no real support, just a message asking if I “agree” with the change. But do I really have a choice? This kind of last-minute change feels very unprofessional and gives the impression that flights are adjusted to fill planes, without considering passengers. Despite high ticket prices (around 2.5 million IDR round trip), there is: no reliability no compensation no real customer support. This experience has been very stressful and disappointing. I would strongly advise avoiding this airline if you have any important schedule.

The airline presented a good hard product but the cabin service is rough around the edges. Prior to online check-in, the airline’s app kept warning that documentation was pending uploading and but would not actually allow any uploading of documents, leading to confusion and misleading warnings about the “FlyReady” status. Attempts to resolve this on the app just lead to going round in circles with the same message appearing warning about “FlyReady” status but no way to actually resolve it (since trying to do so just lead to the same message!) . Excellent ground service at baggage drop at Las Vegas. Boarding commenced about half an hour late due to technical problems with the aircraft but passengers were not kept well informed in the terminal building. The cabin crew chatted amongst themselves whilst we boarded, completely ignoring the passengers walking right in front of them. Some of the crew worked harder than others. Toilets were not all unlocked after take off and one cabin crew member insisted someone had been in the toilet (which had been locked for an hour since take off) which was not the case. Another crew member eventually unlocked the toilet so it could be used (one hour after take off). Food was tasty and plentiful. Good choices of beverages. Excellent inflight entertainment choices although the system was reset for the whole plane twice. We arrived early despite taking off late, thanks to strong tail winds.
